correctness.rationale: The dihedral presentation forces every homomorphism to be zero or uniquely (A,u); idempotence is A²=A, Au=0. Counting complementary kernels yields N_r. Affine conjugation reduces any one projection to (A,0), where its commutant splits into independent projections on im A and ker A; summing kernel translations proves P_{d-r}Q_r. For any finite commuting affine-idempotent family, the product has nonempty image equal to the intersection of its members’ fixed-point sets. A common fixed point permits simultaneous linear diagonalization and gives precisely the Boolean maximal cliques. Unique constant map/coordinate rank-one maps recover the point and line decomposition. The included direct verifier exhaustively tests d≤2 for p=3,5 and every degree at (p,d)=(3,3), with full group-law verification at (3,2). Computation is corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Compatible retractions (composition-commuting idempotent endomorphisms) occur naturally in computational classifications of cat1/cat2-type structures. The claim supplies a uniform exact graph invariant for an infinite nonabelian group family: all vertex-degree multiplicities, exact rank/orbit census and a classification and closed count of every maximal compatible retraction system. The affine geometry is not merely a small numerical special case, and distinguished zero/trivial endomorphisms matter. The rank-one and small-order cases are explicitly reserved to previous work.
